import json
from pathlib import Path

from makemarket.provenance import file_sha256, receipt

root = Path('results/validation')
old = json.loads((root / 'qwen35-rloo192/cohorts.json').read_text())
new = json.loads((root / 'qwen35-rloo384/cohorts.json').read_text())
contrast = root / 'qwen35-rloo384/vs_rloo192.json'
games = json.loads(contrast.read_text())['games']
gain = new['selection_score'] - old['selection_score']
positive = any(g['family_ci'][0] > 0 for g in games.values())
harm = any(g['family_ci'][1] < 0 for g in games.values())
r = {'provenance': receipt({'purpose': 'assess T26 against its registered material-improvement criterion'}, new['provenance']['model_revision']),
     'source': Path(__file__).read_text(), 'trial': 'T26', 'groups_before_after': [192, 384],
     'selection_score_gain_points': gain, 'required_gain_points': 5,
     'one_corrected_paired_lower_above_zero': positive, 'one_corrected_paired_upper_below_zero': harm,
     'real_improvement': gain >= 5 and positive and not harm,
     'validation_percentages': {g: {k: row[k] for k in ('pct_of_bayes', 'pct_of_bayes_ci', 'epnl', 'epnl_ci')} for g,row in new['games'].items()},
     'paired_contrasts': games, 'family_contrasts': 18,
     'input_sha256': {str(p):file_sha256(p) for p in [root/'qwen35-rloo192/cohorts.json',root/'qwen35-rloo384/cohorts.json',contrast]},
     'interpretation': 'Second consecutive nonimprovement after T23. The selection score falls and neither corrected paired lower bound exceeds zero. Stop this unchanged local recipe; freeze the max-min winner across all seven trials. Zero format errors, median spread ratio one and increasing late-round posterior errors point to a state-inference gap; dice-only contextual rewards on fixed teacher states do not train full on-policy cards inference. This is a diagnostic hypothesis, not proof of causality or impossibility. Collect the selected raw-only test; all fresh aggregates remain sealed until the newest-model selection is frozen.'}
Path('results/training/qwen35_rloo384_iteration.json').write_text(json.dumps(r,indent=2)+'\n')
print({'selection_score_gain_points':gain,'real_improvement':r['real_improvement']})
